::::

I am Professor of Economics and Chair of Economics, History and Policy at Stellenbosch University, where I also direct LEAP, [the Laboratory for the Economics of Africa's Past](https://leapstellenbosch.org.za/). I teach economic history to undergraduate and graduate students, and regularly publish on the subject academically, through journal articles and book chapters. Please visit my [research page](research.qmd) to find out more.

My book, [*Our Long Walk to Economic Freedom*](https://www.cambridge.org/core/books/our-long-walk-to-economic-freedom/0985F9390A3B26B40DE0AC6BC1111414) (CUP), offers an accessible and engaging introduction to economic history from an African perspective. Its closing line – 'The future belongs to those who believe in a better tomorrow' – captures my conviction that economic history is fundamentally optimistic: we have the agency to build a more prosperous society.

I see myself as a knowledge broker, who believes that effective science communication matters deeply. Stories not only help us understand the world around us, they actively shape it.

My blog, [ourlongwalk.com](http://www.ourlongwalk.com), now followed by more than 6,000 subscribers, features my columns and essays on a wide variety of topics.

My greatest ambition is to be cited in a Nobel lecture – ideally by one of my students.

```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  // The feed JSON is refreshed by .github/workflows/substack-feed.yml and
  // served same-origin, so this fetch needs no CORS proxies.
  const NUM_POSTS = 3;
  const MONTHS = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June",
    "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];

  function formatDate(iso) {
    if (!iso) return "";
    var p = iso.split("-");
    if (p.length !== 3) return "";
    return parseInt(p[2], 10) + " " + (MONTHS[parseInt(p[1], 10) - 1] || "") + " " + p[0];
  }

  function el(tag, className, text) {
    var node = document.createElement(tag);
    if (className) node.className = className;
    if (text) node.textContent = text;
    return node;
  }

  function renderPosts(posts) {
    var grid = document.getElementById("substack-feed");
    if (!grid) return;
    grid.innerHTML = "";
    posts.slice(0, NUM_POSTS).forEach(function(post) {
      var card = el("a", "substack-card");
      card.href = post.link;
      card.target = "_blank";
      card.rel = "noopener";

      if (post.image) {
        var frame = el("div", "substack-card-img");
        var img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = post.image;
        img.alt = "";
        img.loading = "lazy";
        frame.appendChild(img);
        card.appendChild(frame);
      }

      var body = el("div", "substack-card-body");
      var date = formatDate(post.date);
      if (date) body.appendChild(el("p", "substack-card-date", date));
      body.appendChild(el("p", "substack-card-title", post.title));
      if (post.description) body.appendChild(el("p", "substack-card-desc", post.description));
      card.appendChild(body);
      grid.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  function showFallback() {
    var grid = document.getElementById("substack-feed");
    if (!grid) return;
    grid.innerHTML = "";
    var p = el("p", "substack-fallback", "Visit ");
    var a = el("a", null, "ourlongwalk.com");
    a.href = "https://www.ourlongwalk.com";
    p.appendChild(a);
    p.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" for the latest posts."));
    grid.appendChild(p);
  }

  fetch("data/substack.json")
    .then(function(resp) {
      if (!resp.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + resp.status);
      return resp.json();
    })
    .then(function(data) {
      if (data && data.posts && data.posts.length) renderPosts(data.posts);
      else showFallback();
    })
    .catch(showFallback);
})();
</script>
```
